title: DeepSeek releases V4.1-Flash-1017 open-weight model with agentic tool optimizations
summary: DeepSeek released the V4.1-Flash-1017 open-weight checkpoint under an MIT license, optimizing mixture-of-experts sparse routing for terminal tasks, coding workflows, and reduced output lengths.
research_notes:
Obtain open-weight model checkpoints and community quantization shards distributed under the MIT license.

Serve the model on MoE-compatible inference engines configured for sparse activation and compressed key-value caching over one-million-token context windows.

Connect developer harnesses to the model endpoint, integrating first-party Search and Fetch APIs for web grounding.

Deploy with serving harnesses that support compressed KV-cache management to maintain practical memory footprints across long-context sessions.

Pair the checkpoint with specialized developer harnesses such as DeepSeek Harness to take advantage of shortened output verbosity and faster terminal execution.
